# The consultation Mum led

Mum took her own question card into the appointment and asked me to wait outside. She came back with one unanswered question and a clear plan for asking it. I had expected helping to mean being in the room. [[Care arrangements]] should record where I am unnecessary. The new arrangement is less observable to me and may still be better for her.
